description: Enroll patient portal accounts and record guardian / family delegations with consent.
enroll.title: Counter-assisted enrollment
enroll.help: Creates a portal login for an existing patient. Username defaults to mobile or email.
delegate.title: Guardian / family delegation
delegate.help: Portal access for a dependent is never inferred from demographic guardian fields. Record consent explicitly.
list.title: Portal accounts
errors.generic: Unable to complete the portal administration action.
errors.PORTAL_ACCOUNT_NOT_VERIFIED: This portal account is not verified.
errors.PORTAL_ACCOUNT_EXISTS: A portal account already exists for this patient.
errors.PORTAL_USERNAME_TAKEN: That portal username is already in use.
errors.PORTAL_REPORT_NOT_ACCESSIBLE: That report is not accessible in the portal.
errors.PORTAL_PATIENT_NOT_FOUND: Patient or portal account was not found.
errors.PORTAL_PATIENT_CONTACT_REQUIRED: Patient needs a mobile number or email for portal enrollment.
errors.PORTAL_PASSWORD_TOO_SHORT: Portal password must be at least 8 characters.
errors.PORTAL_DELEGATION_EXISTS: An active delegation already exists for this pair.
errors.PORTAL_DELEGATION_SELF: A patient cannot receive a delegation to their own account.
errors.PORTAL_DELEGATION_REASON_REQUIRED: Relationship and consent reference are required.
reassign.title: Reassign portal username
reassign.help: Release a username from a superseded portal account and enroll the correct patient. The old account is archived and suspended; audit history is preserved.
prompts.reassignReason: Reason for username reassignment (required for audit)
notices.reassigned: Portal username {username} reassigned to selected patient
errors.PORTAL_USERNAME_NOT_HELD: No active portal account holds that username.
errors.PORTAL_USERNAME_MISMATCH: The selected superseded account does not hold that username.
errors.PORTAL_REASSIGN_SAME_PATIENT: That username is already assigned to this patient.
errors.PORTAL_DISABLED_FOR_TENANT: Patient portal is disabled for this tenant.
